title: Deep interview
retryHint: Retry interview feedback by saving again.
ratifyBody1: Your answers are saved as records.
question: Question {{n}} of {{total}}
ratifyDeltaNote: Your answers are saved as-is. We don't invent an estimate now - your stars brighten as records accumulate.
screenerSubtitle: We circle the same core a little differently each time - to see it more clearly.
reflectErrorBody: Your answers are still here. Give it another try in a moment.

loopCheck.stuckLoop: The thing you keep coming back to - is it telling you something new, or are you arriving at the same conclusion each time?
loopCheck.friendView: What would you say to a close friend in this exact situation?
loopCheck.setAside: What would change if you set this thought aside for five minutes?

drill.opening: Which stretch of your life should we start with? One scene that comes to mind is enough.
drill.placeholder: Write as much or as little as you like
drill.closing: It is okay to pause here. Shall I keep what you shared today?
drill.loopNote: Let me change direction for a moment.
drill.failed: Could not fetch the next question. Please try again.
drill.emptyAnswer: Even one line lets us keep going.
drill.saveBody: What you shared is saved as it is. No estimate is invented now; the record feeds star brightness as it accumulates.
drill.scaffoldNote: Not knowing is fine. "I don't know" is data too. Let's come at it another way.
drill.intro: No need to polish your answers. "I don't know" is data too.
drill.openerHint: Tap to start writing, then edit it
